name: Team Board
summary: A shared board your team works from on day one: To Do, In Progress, Done, with owners, due dates and labels already there.
why: Your team needs one place to see who is doing what this week.
can: Drag a task from To Do to Done, and everyone sees it move
Open “Assigned to me” to see only your own work
Assign a task and the person is told straight away

sample_cards.title: Open me and set a due date
